IS 3626 : 2025 Locked Coil Winding Ropes - Specification
ICS 73.100.40; 77.140.65
ICS 73.100.40; 77.140.65
MED 10
MED 10
1 SCOPE
This standard covers locked coil wire ropes used for winding purposes in mines.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards listed below. In case the standards are to be referred in this clause they are to be listed as follows:
